selected_priority: Add attributable source acquisition that produces CompanyIntelligence snapshots from explicit approved sources and feeds the existing provenance-preserving refresh pipeline.
displaced_capability: Helix already had freshness-aware CompanyIntelligence, semantic refresh, company fit, recruiter strategy, queueing, batch execution, and outcome calibration, but no owned executable layer could acquire fresh attributable source material and turn it into the CompanyIntelligence snapshots those downstream systems consume.

mechanisms_compared.assessment: No stronger stranded acquisition runtime was identified by the current JOB_RESTORE continuation state. Earlier static intelligence manifests are useful evidence but are weaker than the current refresh architecture and do not provide an executable acquisition path.

Opaque LLM or generic web summarization could discover broader prose, but it would weaken deterministic attribution, source-bound extraction, and reproducible proof at the exact point where company facts enter recruiter strategy.

Selected: explicit source plans plus approved-domain HTTP acquisition, deterministic HTML/JSON/text extraction, content-addressed source receipts, and direct composition into the already-proven refresh engine. This closes the upstream gap while preserving every downstream interface.

capabilities: executes explicit company source plans over HTML, JSON, and plain text without an opaque summarization dependency
requires absolute HTTP(S) sources and declared allowed domains before acquisition
revalidates the final redirected hostname so an approved source cannot redirect acquisition outside the declared domain boundary

emits standard CompanyIntelligence snapshots with attributable source URL, source title, and observation timestamp
fails when acquisition yields no attributable signal rather than producing an empty success artifact
writes incoming intelligence and acquisition receipts atomically
optionally composes acquired intelligence directly through refresh_company_intelligence and persist_refresh so existing freshness, retirement, and provenance semantics remain authoritative
